endpoints.description: National Broadband Data Collection availability files (BDC)
Resolve lat/lon to Census block / county / state (FCC Area API)

limits.notes: Mixed: Broadband Data Collection (BDC) API requires a registered username + API hash token; the geo.fcc.gov Area API and License View are open (no key). Verify BDC auth header names and any per-token limits against the current BDC spec.

llmDocs.summary: Broadband availability/coverage (FCC National Broadband Map / BDC), lat-lon-to-census-geography lookups (Area API), and spectrum license search (License View). Three distinct services under one source.
llmDocs.queryGuide: For point-to-geography lookups use geo.fcc.gov/api/census/area?lat=&lon=&format=json (open). For broadband availability use the BDC published-data API with username + hash token headers. For licenses use License View basicSearch with format=json.
gotchas: Three different hosts/services; only BDC requires auth — route per function.
BDC availability data is large and file-based (downloadable datasets), not row-level point queries.
Confirm current BDC API auth scheme; FCC has changed token/header conventions over time.

compliance.redistributionNotes: Public domain US government data. BDC availability data has provider-submitted accuracy caveats; note as-of dates.
